question: Should assistant-message plain-text copy be implemented as a Markdown/plain-text copy menu, a persisted default-copy-format preference, or a smaller one-shot plain-text action?
rationale: The code boundary is narrow, but the issue proposes multiple UX shapes and maintainers need to define how Markdown constructs and hidden assistant text should paste as plain text.

options.title: Copy Menu
options.body: Add a compact menu or split action with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text, leaving any default-format preference for a later decision.

options.title: Persisted Preference
options.body: Add a default copy-format preference and keep the visible message copy button as one action, accepting the extra settings, persistence, and i18n surface.

options.title: Decline Core Change
options.body: Keep Markdown-only copy behavior if maintainers decide plain-text clipboard formatting is not worth the Control UI surface.

recommendation.title: Copy Menu
recommendation.body: Add a compact menu or split action with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text, leaving any default-format preference for a later decision.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the copy UX decision.
